contract: Compare the encoded metadata, recovery and dependency views with the public MOV demuxer using +noparse+nofillin.

Compare each stream's id, kind, clock, seek preroll, codec name, exact configuration bytes, language, handler, vendor, creation time and skip-samples stream side data. Creation time compares the formatted compatibility value.
Each packet folds stream index, PTS and DTS with their presence bits and raw values, duration, physical position, flags, size and every payload byte in delivery order.
Compare packet skip-samples side data and terminal EOF or refusal. Dependency flags compare as demuxed flags where SDTP contributes the disposable bit.
Input loading and schedule parsing precede the operation. Both sides open, consume and release their readers inside it.

pending_module_requirements: The metadata view (EncodedStreamJob::new_description_with_metadata) refuses a version-1 mp4a wave without frma (Unsupported: encoded incomplete mp4a wave context). Apple QuickTime File Format 'Sound sample data' only recommends frma and has unknown atoms ignored; the entry's esds is present and the reference reads 458 bytes.

The encoded recovery profile refuses a sample-to-group map that leaves samples without an explicit association (Unsupported: encoded incomplete recovery coverage); ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.9.2.3 assigns them to the default group, or none.
The encoded recovery profile refuses an sbgp run with sample_count 0 (Invalid: encoded empty recovery run); no clause of ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.9.2 forbids an empty run.

The encoded recovery profile refuses valid ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.9 group syntax it does not implement: a version-1 sbgp grouping_type_parameter, a grouping type it does not know (4.2: skip what is not recognised) and sgpd version 1 with default_length 0.

The dependency profile refuses a file that also carries a referenced roll group (Unsupported: encoded dependency view nonempty recovery descriptions); sdtp and roll are independent sample facts (ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.6.4, 8.9).

open_deviations.reading: An absent, nonempty or nonfinal wave terminator
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description extensions’, ‘siDecompressionParam atom (wave)’ and ‘Terminator atom’: a terminator marks the end and contains no payload; the strict wave profile requires it
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the three wave layouts (Invalid: encoded wave child after terminator; Invalid: encoded wave terminator data; Unsupported: encoded incomplete mp4a wave context)
open_deviations.reference: opens and reads 458 packet payload bytes in each case

open_deviations.reading: A wave format atom that contradicts its sample entry
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format 'Format atom (frma)': frma names the format of the data the entry describes; here it names ac-3 inside an mp4a entry
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the entry (Unsupported: encoded wave format conflicts with entry)
open_deviations.reference: opens the entry as AAC and reads 458 packet payload bytes

open_deviations.reading: Compressed sound without the framed table mode required by the view
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ ‘Redefined sample tables’ explains compression ID -2 and sample tables whose units are compressed frames
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the entry: compression ID 0 for MPEG-4 audio (Unsupported: encoded sound-v1 frame-table compression ID)
open_deviations.reference: opens the entry as AAC and reads 458 packet payload bytes

open_deviations.reading: A sample group index outside its description namespace
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.9.2.3 and 8.9.4: group_description_index is 0 or 1 to the sgpd entry_count, and indices above 0x10000 name fragment-local descriptions, which stbl cannot hold
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the dangling index and the fragment-local index in stbl (Invalid: encoded unresolved recovery description; Unsupported: encoded fragment recovery namespace)
open_deviations.reference: opens and reads 4379 packet payload bytes in each case

open_deviations.reading: Two group description boxes for one grouping type
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 §§8.9.2.1–.3 and 8.9.3.1–.3: at most one sgpd per grouping_type in a sample table
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the second sgpd (Invalid: encoded duplicate recovery context)
open_deviations.reference: opens and reads 4379 packet payload bytes

open_deviations.reading: A reserved sample dependency field on a referenced sample
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the table (Unsupported: encoded dependency view reserved depended-on value)
open_deviations.reference: opens and reads 4379 packet payload bytes

open_policies.policy: Wave policy the format leaves open: a repeated esds or frma atom
open_policies.undecided: Apple QuickTime File Format 'siDecompressionParam atom (wave)' lists one format and one decoder atom and says nothing of a second copy; the metadata profile refuses duplicates
open_policies.rule: refuses the second atom (Unsupported: encoded duplicate configuration box; Invalid: encoded duplicate wave format)
open_policies.reference_rule: opens the entry as AAC and reads 458 packet payload bytes

open_policies.policy: Group policy the standard leaves to the reader: a sample-to-group map longer than the track
open_policies.undecided: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 8.9.2.3: a total above sample_count is an error and reader behaviour is then undefined
open_policies.rule: refuses the overlong map (Invalid: encoded recovery exceeds samples)
open_policies.reference_rule: opens and reads 4379 packet payload bytes
